main_text.p: dùm leges. Conveniunt quotannis ter in classibus suis deliberandi & statuendi causâ statò tempore & loco. Et ut plerăque alia communia habent, sic hos quoque conventus classes Delficæ propter clauftrorum suorum conjunctionem: habent & Winsumanæ duæ, curantes clauftra totidem. In his conventibus, si res requirere videatur, decernitur tributum: id colligitur per inferiores: collectum traditur superioribus: ab his apud præsidem summum: ubi præses hujusmodi est, deponitur: is ex decreto communi impendit, quo poscit usus. In controversiis mos fuit in classibus Delficis, (puto etiam in Winsumanâ utrâque & Adoardianâ) si quis læsum se sententiâ aut mandato inferiorum arbitraretur, appellare superiores, post hos ad cognitionem vocare etiam cæteros ejusdem ordinis in classibus iisdem cum summo præside, ab istis quod decretum esset ratum habere, nec tendere longius: Post ex conventione sic institutum inter Delfenses, Winsumanos, Adoardios, ut ab unis ad proximos, à proximis ad ter-

page.notes: The running head is printed "Deque Vrbe Groninga." and is given with u for the vowel. The page number is printed "31" (the "3" and "I" are set with a space). The first word "dùm" carries a grave accent over the u as printed; the accent is doubtful. "plerăque" has a breve over the a as printed. The word "statò"/"statò" has a grave accent as printed. The mark after "tio" at the foot is read as the catchword "tios" [?]; it is faint and may be "tios". The line "ter-" ends with a printed hyphen; the rest of the word is on the next page. The parenthesis around "(puto ... Adoardianâ)" is printed as shown. No marginal notes or other furniture are visible. The show-through and the faint digitiser mark at the lower right are left out.
